manifest.curves: full ROC/PR arrays for splits and TMA contexts
manifest.curve_threshold_convention: sklearn ROC/PR curves use score >= threshold; formal classification tables use the separately recorded strict > rule.
manifest.missing_score_policy: All labelled rows retained; full-set metrics NaN if any score nonfinite.
manifest.uncertainty_warning: Member disagreement is descriptive, not calibrated uncertainty.
manifest.statistical_policy: Seed SD is descriptive, not patient-level confidence intervals; no cell bootstrap or significance test.
